Figure 12:Diversity and visual quality comparison on Wan 2.1 1.3B.Four-step generation results for the prompt“A woman in a street”across three noise seeds. DMD2 and AnyFlow produce visually similar facial structures and appearances across different seeds, indicating limited generative diversity, while rCM exhibits substantial degradation in visual quality. In contrast, our Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD) generates diverse facial identities, poses, clothing, and street backgrounds while maintaining high visual fidelity and prompt alignment. These results highlight PMD’s ability to preserve sample diversity and generation quality under the same four-step sampling budget.
